shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules | wc -l

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/index.d.ts; ls controls; echo ---; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; sed -n 1,80p Select/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls Select

cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; grep -n "ControlProps" -A12 types.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p Select/tech-components.d.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "export" Text/index.d.ts | head; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat controls/types.d.ts | head -30

cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "export type SelectOption\b" -A12 Select/types.d.ts; grep -n "multiple\|filterable\|hasClear" Select/types.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "type SelectOption<" -A10 Select/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn "validationState\|errorMessage" controls/TextInput/TextInput.js | head -3; ls ../../../../../../ | head -0; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep -n '"peerDependencies"' -A6

cat Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "imgUrl\|text?" Avatar/AvatarImage/*.d.ts Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts Avatar/types/*.d.ts | head; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p Alert/Alert.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "TEXT_COLORS" -A3 Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "'positive'\|danger" Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; echo ---; cat layout/index.d.ts; echo ---; cat Text/text/text.d.ts | grep -n "variant" | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -60

rm -rf dist && timeout 300 npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "EXIT=$?"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer" ; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
timeout 300 npx vitest run src/profile/ssr-smoke.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -40

rm -f src/profile/ssr-smoke.test.tsx && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6 && rm -rf dist && timeout 300 npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Files|Tests|FAIL|✓|×" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short
